mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO telemetry_value_rollup ( bucket_start, bucket_sec, variable_name, min_value, max_value, avg_value, sample_count ) VALUES
(#{item.bucketStart}, #{item.bucketSec}, #{item.variableName}, #{item.minValue}, #{item.maxValue}, #{item.avgValue}, #{item.sampleCount})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE min_value = LEAST(min_value, VALUES(min_value)), max_value = GREATEST(max_value, VALUES(max_value)), avg_value = (avg_value * sample_count + VALUES(avg_value) * VALUES(sample_count)) / (sample_count + VALUES(sample_count)), sample_count = sample_count + VALUES(sample_count)
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(bucket_start) FROM telemetry_value_rollup WHERE variable_name = #{variableName} AND bucket_sec = #{bucketSec}
